punchline: Peter Thiel's favorite interview question stumps most candidates: what important truth do very few people agree with you on?
thirty_sec: Peter Thiel likes to ask job candidates one thing: what important truth do very few people agree with you on? Most can't answer. It takes knowledge others don't have and the nerve to say something unpopular, so people repeat the conventional view. Thiel argues great companies are built on exactly these overlooked truths. Airbnb, for example, saw untapped supply and unaddressed demand where others saw nothing.
question: What do you believe from your own experience that most people would doubt?
